storage.notes: microSD card slot (maximum capacity not stated).

features: infrared and white-light colour night modes
iCSee app (per the PoE PTZ family setup guide)
release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.); the page states 5MP for the -50P model (an 8MP -80P model is offered on the same page as a separate variant with no other separate specs, so it is not recorded here), wired IEEE 802.3af / 48V PoE, H.265, two-way audio, pan/tilt, human detection and a microSD slot. RTSP path from the QuarkView PT825 PoE camera family manual linked on the page (main stream only; default user admin with an empty password, default IP 192.168.1.10); the same manual states ONVIF and RTSP support. Pan/tilt angles, lens, field of view, frame rate, IP rating, sensor and dimensions are not published on this page.

frigate.notes: Main-stream path from the QuarkView PT825 PoE camera family manual (Xiongmai platform). The manual does not document a sub-stream; on Xiongmai firmware it is usually stream=1.sdp, but confirm via ONVIF discovery before using it for detect. Set a password first: the factory password is empty.

home_assistant.notes: Use the ONVIF integration; the manual lists ONVIF support but not the ONVIF port.

blue_iris.notes: Add as a generic ONVIF/RTSP camera (Xiongmai platform).
